text:
Ajay Patel: Quick sync — I want to expose a 'preview' mode in the console for runtime config changes (dry-run that shows routing effects) before flipping flags to production. Thinking 10% shadow traffic first. Thoughts?
Maria Chen: love the idea. can we make preview non-invasive (no quota changes) and only return a diff, not actually route? :+1:
Julie Park: UX Q — where would the preview live? a new tab on the flag page or inline toggle? pref to keep it inline near rollout controls.
Ethan Zhou: main product risk is blind sampling bias — if preview sees different cohorts than live, it's useless. need sampling parity (cohort hashing) + record of fingerprint.
Ajay Patel: agreed. plan: preview = same selector/cookie hashing, sample small pct, but all ops effects are simulated. telemetry written to a separate "preview" namespace. no quota consumption.
Maria Chen: can we get the API contract nailed down? proposal: POST /config/preview with body: ```json
{"flag": "route_by_cost", "percent": 10, "mode": "shadow", "dry_run": true}``` returns a diff blob with estimated routed counts and a representative sample of request ids.
Ethan Zhou: returning request ids sounds like PII risk. instead return aggregated histograms and example traces (scrubbed) that reference trace ids only.
Ajay Patel: good call. change to aggregated buckets + trace refs. Also want a lightweight sim run in the Control Plane that uses current kv-cache + routing rules so results are realistic.
Julie Park: on console side, we should show a small chart: "expected % routed to variant A/B", a per-route latency delta estimate, and a link to a trace view. Keep it minimal so engs can make a call quickly.
config-bot: Note: preview runs are rate-limited — 5 previews/min per org. Results persisted for 24h.
Maria Chen: telemetry gating detail: require at least 5k simulated requests for estimates to be meaningful, otherwise UI shows "low confidence". Also add bootstrap prior to avoid extreme variance.
Ethan Zhou: backend concerns: simulation must not increase tail latency for serving path. Suggest we run sims offlined on a sampled copy of recent request logs instead of live path. That also solves quota issue.
Ajay Patel: hmm, offlined sim reduces fidelity (no live kv state). tradeoff. Maybe hybrid: run fast on live-in-memory snapshot (read-only) with strict cpu/cgroup, fallback to offline logs if resource pressure detected.
Julie Park: UX flow for operators: "Run preview" -> modal with sample size slider + checkbox "persist preview results" -> run -> toast + link to results page. If low confidence, warn with :warning: and suggestion to increase sample.
Maria Chen: approval flow: previews tagged as "sensitive" if they touch quota/rate-limit rules, requires 1 approver. Flag changes still gated by normal review.
Ajay Patel: ops runbook addendum: preview failure modes: 1) sim timeout -> abort, 2) mismatch > X% vs baseline -> alert ops and surface rollback suggestions, 3) resource pressure -> auto-fail to offline logs. ops-bot: will create alert on failure.
ops-bot: Created alert: preview-sim-timeout (severity: high).
Ethan Zhou: API implementation detail debate: synchronous vs async? For larger sample runs we need async with polling. For small quick previews (<1k) sync ok.
Maria Chen: agreed. add an idempotency-key header so retrying doesn't spawn duplicate sims.
Ajay Patel: one more: privacy/PII check before storing any sample. Add scrubber pipeline stage. I'll draft an RFC with schema + example responses. Anyone want to take a pass on the RFC before end of week?
Julie Park: happy to review the console bits.
Ethan Zhou: I'll sketch the sim/worker design and resource limits.
Maria Chen: I'll own the API contract and telemetry metrics (confidence intervals, sample count, comparison deltas).
Ajay Patel: thanks all. I'll post a short RFC link when it's up. For now, I'll open a small canary: preview UI toggle in staging behind "preview-ui" flag, and a backend endpoint in alpha.
config-bot: FYI — staging preview endpoint available at /alpha/config/preview (auth required).
Ajay Patel: merging plan: alpha in staging, 10% shadow sample in staging for 48h, then expand to internal orgs, then gradual 1% increments to customers behind an "opt-in preview" feature.
Julie Park: sounds good. can we add a small telemetry panel in Console beta that only internal users see? makes iteration faster.
Ethan Zhou: also logging: ensure preview runs emit a `preview.run_id` tag for trace correlation.
Maria Chen: noted. will include metric names in RFC: `preview.sample_count`, `preview.confidence`, `preview.estimate_delta`.
